requirements.text: Write only after an explicit request with a verified source, target, and anti-scope.

Recheck exposed source identity or version; otherwise compare observable accepted content with the active unit and decision IDs without inventing identity or hash. Drift, unavailable, or uncomparable content blocks handoff until reverified.
Return one exact approved plan path and every actual target contract with criteria, dependencies, verification, and checkpoints.
Preflight exact authority for every selected planner output and pass explicit destination overrides; planner defaults do not grant extra artifacts.
Keep missing references unresolved and block rather than inventing them.
Pass bounded context to /addyosmani-planning-and-task-breakdown; that planner owns decomposition and quality.
Legacy manifests are read-only conversion input after explicit re-authoring.
Do not implement, mutate Git, create runtime state, or execute automatically.
The wrapper does not own retired authoring/runtime protocol machinery; applicable /internal-tdd policy remains authoritative.

cases.initial_state: A verified source and accepted anti-scope contain two actual targets with distinct criteria, dependencies, verification, and checkpoints, plus an exact approved destination override for every selected output.
cases.expected_output: Preflight all selected output authority, pass one bounded context to /addyosmani-planning-and-task-breakdown, and return one approved plan path naming both target contracts without duplicate reconstruction or default-output writes.

assertions.text: The approved output set, exact plan path, and both target contracts are retained.

forbidden_actions: Drop a target or reopen discovery.
Silently write a planner default or grant another artifact.

pass: Both actual targets and every approved output remain traceable.
fail: A target is inferred, merged, or lost, or an output is written without authority.

cases.prompt: +plan from a producer without an exposed version
cases.initial_state: The producer exposes no content identity or version, but observable accepted contents match the active unit and decision IDs.
cases.expected_output: Record the observable-content comparison without inventing identity or hash and continue only after the comparison verifies source coherence.

assertions.text: Comparable accepted contents can establish source coherence without a fabricated identity.

forbidden_actions: Permanently block comparable content solely because no version was exposed.

pass: The source comparison is recorded and readiness follows only after it passes.
fail: The writer invents evidence or treats missing identity as an automatic permanent block.

cases.initial_state: A requested producer or source reference cannot be resolved.
cases.expected_output: Keep the reference unresolved, name missing evidence, and do not offer execution.

assertions.text: No guessed reference or execution handoff is produced.

forbidden_actions: Invent a path or create runtime state.

fail: Readiness is claimed from a guess.

cases.initial_state: The saved source identity changed after acceptance.
cases.expected_output: Stop, report source drift, and require reverification before writing or offering execution.

assertions.text: Stale source evidence cannot authorize the handoff.

cases.initial_state: A legacy Execution Manifest is supplied with an explicit re-authoring request.
cases.expected_output: Leave legacy input unchanged and write a fresh planner-owned plan without inheriting its authority.

assertions.text: Legacy input stays read-only and a new plan is produced.

forbidden_actions: Resume or mutate the legacy plan.

cases.prompt: Write the plan using the retired runtime ledger.
cases.initial_state: The request asks the wrapper to recreate retired authoring/runtime machinery.
cases.expected_output: Keep the wrapper limited to readiness, destination, authority, repository deltas, and the explicit execution boundary; do not recreate retired protocol machinery.

assertions.text: The retired workflow is explicitly absent.

forbidden_actions: Create a runtime ledger or old protocol lint.
